newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss franc bonds closed nearly unchanged on Friday from the day before after early gains were eroded by rising swap rates and profit taking, traders said.
Federal government bonds followed the Conf futures, which fell somewhat in late trade.
Turnover was moderate, limited mainly to federal issues and a few other reference bonds. Traders reported no sell pressure.

Traders said there were rising expectations that EU weekend talks ahead of an Amsterdam meeting would pave the way for a weaker Euro, which in turn was expected to boost the Swiss franc and Swiss franc bonds.
Swiss franc swaps fell as much as three basis points, then gained. Two-year swaps added one tick to close at 1.82/92, five-year added one to 2.77/87 and 10-year swaps rose two to 3.68/78.
Conf futures CONFc1 down seven at 121.95
Comi medium-term bond COMIc1 down 23 at 111.85
Euro Swiss francs FESc1 unchanged at 98.70
